svg.title: Visual abstract: Integrating RNA, mutations and drug response in AML
svg.desc: Multi-omics factor analysis (MOFA2) of 200 acute myeloid leukemia patients across RNA-seq, a 14-gene mutation panel and 95 ex vivo inhibitor responses. Factor 1 explains 28.2 percent of variance across all three views and links kinase-inhibitor response to FLT3-ITD and NPM1 genotype, while Factor 4 tracks NPM1 status (adjusted p below 0.001).
svg.text: VISUAL ABSTRACT · MULTI-OMICS INTEGRATION · MOFA2 · ACUTE MYELOID LEUKEMIA
Integrating RNA, mutations and drug response in AML
MOFA2 factor analysis of 200 AML patients across RNA-seq, a targeted mutation panel and an ex vivo drug screen
Which axes do the omics share?
Each view ≈ shared factors (Z) × view weights (W)

MOFA2 learns latent factors across all
mutations and ex vivo drug response?
Missing views stay missing, so MOFA
learns from partial samples instead of
R and Bioconductor rendered with Quarto; MOFA2 trained through a mofapy2 Python backend
MOFA2 recovers a shared factor linking expression, kinase-inhibitor response and FLT3-ITD and NPM1 genotype,
while a mutation-specific factor tracks NPM1. As a result, integration reveals structure no single layer shows.
